name: Tarrek Veyran
found: Tarrek's Forge, at the anvil from dawn.
appearance: Gruff, broad, soot-stained, a leather apron scorched through.
sayings: Settle it outside. Not in my forge.
wants: A well-run forge and to be left to work.
oddly_also: Settles disputes when Hadran can't, because people trust him. Believes in the gods less than most.
offers: Metalwork, repairs, and plain answers if asked directly.
family: Elder sister Morla, a healer; apprentices Garrin and Felmar.
anecdotes: Stood neutral witness at the trial by combat between Tenn Darnel and Ulan Caernach.
